description: Mexicans deported from the US are dropped off all along the border, in cities US officials describe as safer than the alternatives - but not necessarily near home, and not necessarily anywhere he has been before.
energy_note: Returned to his country, two thousand kilometres from it.

aspect: Getting home is his own problem and he has no money
description: The bus fare from a border city to a southern state is real money, which he does not have, having had his belongings not returned (DOC-003).
energy_note: A day and a half on a bus he cannot pay for.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the offer of a ride home is mostly declined
description: Ten Mexican reception centres reported 12,200 overnight stays and 9,300 debit cards issued, but only about 2,000 accepted free transport back to their home states - most do not take the ride south, because they intend to try again.
energy_note: Nine thousand helped, two thousand going home.

description: The gate opens, six men walk through, and it closes. No phone, no belt, no laces, and $4 in coins between them. A car has been parked across the street the whole time, and it starts its engine.
energy_note: The car across the road starts its engine.
